t: Quantum Annealer: Annealing Schedule Designer — Simple
name: Quantum Annealer: Annealing Schedule Designer — Simple
title: Quantum Annealer: Annealing Schedule Designer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] The anneal interpolates from quantum to classical: the designer sets the schedule s(t) and computes the minimum gap along the path — the gap sets the required slowness via the adiabatic theorem.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Adiabatic time for gap 1 GHz = 1.0e-09 s. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

signature_version: Signature version: the manifestation schedule desk — the chapter's target as the gap target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.

t: Quantum Annealer: Tunneling Rate Desk — Simple
name: Quantum Annealer: Tunneling Rate Desk — Simple
title: Quantum Annealer: Tunneling Rate Desk — Simple
description:

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Boltzmann factor for 1 eV barrier at 15 mK = 0.0e+00 factor. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

real_world_basis: Tunneling-vs-thermal comparison is the real analysis of annealer advantage.
signature_version: Signature version: the manifestation tunneling desk — the chapter's target as the advantage target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the advantage is barrier-specific — measure yours, don't assume tall-and-thin.
